profile.summary: I am currently working as a Senior Flight Software Engineer at Anduril Industries. I have experience as a software design lead, software integrated product team deputy, agile process Scrum Master and Product Owner, C++ embedded development, python test development, JavaScript SharePoint development, and R/python data analytics for Northrop. I graduated from the University of Southern California with a M.S. in Computer Science (Data Science) in 2019 and from The Master's University in May 2016 with two degrees: a B.S. in Computer Science and a B.A. in Applied Mathematics. I was a four-year member of The Master's University varsity baseball team and am the winningest player in program history and two-time GSAC champion. I have a passion for learning new programming skills and languages and for mentoring younger engineers.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Responsible for decommissioning old computers throughout the company. Involved using the ticketing system to contact people and locate computers and laptops, wipe government sensitive data, and ship them back to the depot. Suggested improvements to the decommissioning process that are being considered by higher management.

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description: Adapted a client-health care provider web application from C to Java. Application keeps track of patients and their providers. Required knowledge of Java, HTML, SQL, Vaadin, and Eclipse.
